claims.subject: canonical-name
claims.statement: Canonical profile name is NetTraveler.
claims.verification_rationale: The name is corpus-backed but lacks an independent canonical authority.

claims.subject: threat-cluster
claims.statement: NetTraveler is classified as threat-cluster.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=research; actor type is audited independently of geography.

claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: NetTraveler was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-threat-actor. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.

claims.subject: espionage
claims.statement: NetTraveler has motivation espionage: Kaspersky explicitly describes the activity as cyber espionage and documents theft of sensitive technical and government information.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=research; motivation is not inferred from sponsorship.

claims.subject: relationship--nettraveler--danti-suspected
claims.statement: NetTraveler related-to actor--danti: KasperskyはDantiの起源を不明とした上で、NetTravelerおよびDragonOKとの接続可能性を疑っていると記述した。
claims.verification_rationale: This is a vendor-stated suspicion, not proof of shared operators or exact identity. Publication date records the assessment date only.

claims.subject: activity--nettraveler-red-star-2004-2013
claims.statement: NetTraveler conducted or is associated with NetTraveler／Red Starサイバースパイ活動: Kasperskyは、モンゴル、ロシア、インド、カザフスタン、キルギス、中国、タジキスタン、韓国、スペイン、ドイツ、米国、カナダ、英国、チリ、モロッコ、ギリシャ、ベルギー、オーストリア、ウクライナ、リトアニア、ベラルーシ、オーストラリア、香港、日本、イラン、トルコ、パキスタン、タイ、カタール、ヨルダンを含む40か国で侵害を確認した。標的は政府機関、大使館、石油・ガス、研究機関、大学、防衛・軍事請負企業、活動家等で、NetTravelerマルウェアを用いて機微情報を窃取した。
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=research; observation dates remain separate from report dates.
